description:
Filed to fix a red develop: develop bac027b42 fails each_place_a_binary_gains_a_second_holder_marks_it_shared. Fix is PR #801 (Optimize).

## Why
#795 (fz-9x7.41.2) has compiled code place a list cell. The cell shared its head only for LIST|STRUCT, through fz_mark_published_ref_aliased, so a binary list head was never marked: the Run row reads (1,0) where (2,1) is expected. #796 (fz-nml.29.2) and #795 went through CI apart, so the combination first ran on develop. Separately, stored_form (a store into a tuple) asked a value's kind even when its type said binary, so a typed value took the ~20-instruction dispatch (Make Distiller Fast's c1 probe).

## What changes
A list cell and a tuple store share through CodegenFn::share / share_as(value, class), with the class taken from the type. Generated code makes no runtime share call.

## Done when
The second-holder test passes on all three paths. The cell parity test watches the bitstring head's words and fails without the fix. c1 falls back toward its pre-nml.29 figure.
title: A list cell and a tuple store share through the one inline share
